_what: How each MACULA GREEK phrase rule is read by the clean builder (stage S1): the same kinds as tables/hebrew/heads.json, so the two languages build the same structure. MACULA marks NO heads in the Greek (surveyed 2026-09-27: 168 rules, 0 head marks), so every convention is here. Clause COMPLEXES (Conj-CL, sub-CL, that-VP, CLaCL, ClCl, aCLaCL, notCLbutCL2CL ...) need no entry: a group holding only connectives and clauses is read as a complex whatever its rule. `2Advp_h1` / `2Advp_h2` name their own head.
_greek_only: Kept, not dropped: `periphrastic` (a form of εἰμί with a participle, BeVerb / VerbBe) and `demonstrative`; the article (DetNP) is structural like the Hebrew article.
